data.app_name: xFIT: Powered by World of Dance
data.description:
Join 30,000 players loving our top-rated fitness games!

**LOADED WITH FEATURES**

xFIT is our most advanced and feature-packed fitness app yet, with content like nothing else in the world of XR fitness.

**A TRAINER LIKE NO OTHER**

Train with an AI coach so real, it’s like having a workout buddy by your side. Choose top trainers like fitness star Daisy Keech, TikTok icon Enola Bedard, Kida the Great, or Josh Killacky – or create your own with over 800 customization options.

{1634209037192497}

**GET THE RESULTS YOU WANT**

Crush fun, rhythm-driven workouts that build strength, boost cardio, and leave you feeling unstoppable.

{1278496559952887}

**AWESOME MUSIC**

Unleash your energy with electrifying tracks, custom-produced by the renowned World of Dance team.

**SOCIAL PLATFORM**

Stay connected and motivated with real-time multiplayer modes, live leaderboards, a viral clip editor, and more. Fitness is better together!

**MIXED REALITY**

Step into breathtaking, best-of-class VR worlds or transform your own space with immersive Mixed Reality workouts.

{949846587061520}

**FITTER THAN EVER**

More than just smashing beats — xFIT delivers a full-body workout experience with 64 unique challenges, 8 pro-level programs to push your limits, and wellness routines for recovery, posture, and flexibility. Track your journey with detailed fitness dashboards.

{1297681894978663}
